# Yulya Studio

> Next-generation browser-native game & web app studio, Monaco code IDE, isolated live host, and community online arcade powered by Gemini 3.x AI.

URL: https://studio.yulya.me
Sandbox Origin: https://play.yulya.me
Docs: https://studio.yulya.me/docs
Arcade: https://studio.yulya.me/arcade
Templates: https://studio.yulya.me/templates
Full LLM Documentation: https://studio.yulya.me/llms-full.txt

## What is Yulya Studio?
Yulya Studio is an all-in-one web platform where creators can build, prompt, bundle (HTML5, Canvas 2D, WebGL, Three.js, GLSL shaders, and React + TypeScript via in-browser esbuild-wasm), test, play, and publish interactive games and web apps directly in their browser with zero local installation.

## Core Pillars & Capabilities
- **Browser-Native Monaco IDE**: Full VS Code-grade editing with multi-file explorer, folder persistence, Command Palette (`Ctrl+K` / `Ctrl+P`), Visual Asset Previewer, and live in-browser `esbuild-wasm` TypeScript/React bundling.
- **Gemini 3.x AI Copilot & Asset Studio**: Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) agent supporting Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with surgical `edit_file` patches, Plan vs Build mode, automatic pre-edit Checkpoints with Monaco Diff rollback, true Multimodal Vision (`inspect_game_screen`), Click-to-Edit visual element picker, Nano Banana 2.1 sprite/texture generation, and Gemini 3.8 TTS audio generation.
- **Dedicated Origin Sandbox (`play.yulya.me`)**: Public games and private previews execute on a strictly isolated origin (`play.yulya.me`) with zero studio cookies, strict CSP, and HMAC-SHA256 signed private preview tokens.
- **Community Arcade & Instant Hosting**: Publish public games in one click to `https://studio.yulya.me/{username}/{slug}` with theater/fullscreen play wrapper, likes, comments, leaderboards (`YulyaSDK.submitScore`), embed codes, abuse reporting, and creator opt-in Remixing (disabled by default).
- **Owner-Only ZIP Export & Account Security**: Creators retain 100% IP ownership, export clean `.zip` archives, manage active sessions & password resets, and purge accounts immediately in `/settings`.
- **Server-Side AES-256-GCM Encryption (with AAD)**: User Gemini API keys are encrypted over TLS and stored using authenticated AES-256-GCM bound to the owner's user ID, never logged or returned in plaintext.
